versions.changelog:
OKX Market API skill initial release.

- Query real-time token prices, candlestick (K-line) data, market trades, and historical price info.
- Aggregate index price across over 100 DEX & CEX from multiple blockchains (EVM/Solana/Sui supported).
- Search for tokens, view details, rankings, and major holders.
- Requires OKX Web3 API authentication for use.
- Provides REST API endpoints and code samples for integration.
